summary: T1 Energy Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on October 6, 2026, attaching a Skadden legal opinion as to the validity of shares registered on an automatic shelf (Form S-3ASR, File No. 333-292857). The prospectus supplement covers resale by Evervolt Green Energy Holding Pte, Ltd. of 7,246,377 shares issued as partial consideration for T1's purchase of intellectual property and related assets under an IP purchase agreement dated July 28, 2026. No new securities are being sold, no proceeds accrue to T1, and the notice is routine registration mechanics rather than a special situation.
